instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, schedules, sheets, and built-in export commands. Start from a blank Revit project. Using the Revit GUI, model a single-storey twin studio building with an overall rectangular footprint of 14.0 m by 10.0 m near the project origin. The exterior walls should define the full footprint and rise about 3.2 m, with one ground slab and a roof covering the same footprint at the top of the storey. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, six IfcSpace entities, nine IfcWall entities, one IfcSlab, one IfcRoof, four IfcDoor entities, and six IfcWindow entities. Do not include IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include at least two studio spaces, two bath spaces, and two kitchenette spaces. Export a two-page Revit sheet PDF named result.pdf; its sheet text must include A101 GROUND FLOOR PLAN, A201 SOUTH ELEVATION, Studio A, and Studio B. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
